_comment: The per-call mediator record (docs/CONTRACTS.md section NEW-mediator-record): what each
model request a turn made carried, and what came back. The requests (reproducible) are
`counters.model_calls`; what came back (the provider's counts and the clock) is
`volatile.model_calls` on the --json TaskRecord and `model_calls` on the `turn` audit
record, beside tokens_in as the two already are. One
`model_call` audit record per request joins both halves when [audit] is on. A causal
readout (benchmarks/results/causal-2026-11) parses them without reading the code, so a
key renamed or a value added is a contract change. packages/gnomon-core/src/
mediator_record.test.ts emits every shape here and asserts its keys against this file,
and that CONTRACTS.md names the section, the kind, the key and every value.
record_only: Under the default (chars4) nothing in the loop reads the record back: the request bodies of three scripted runs hash to the value taken on master before it existed (mediator_record.test.ts). Under calibrated, the trims' budget is divided by the session's measured ratio; nothing else changes.
